test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the Economic Survey 2023-24, India's cumulative installed solar power capacity reached ____ on 30 April 2024, after adding 15.03 GW in 2023-24.
solution:
The correct answer is __**82.64 GW**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India's cumulative installed solar power capacity reached **82.64 GW** as of 30 April 2024.
 
• In the financial year **2023-24**, India** added 15.03 GW of solar power capacity**.
 
• This substantial increase signifies India's continuous progress in renewable energy adoption, particularly solar energy.
 
• The solar energy sector in India has been rapidly expanding, contributing significantly to the nation's renewable energy targets.
 
• These figures are in alignment with the goals set by the Indian government to enhance solar power infrastructure and capacity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Solar Mission**

 
 
• Launched in 2010, it aims to promote the development and use of solar energy for power generation and other uses.
 
• The mission **targets installing 100 GW of grid-connected solar power projects by 2022**.
 
• It includes both solar photovoltaic (PV) and solar thermal technologies.
 
• The mission is a major part of India's commitment to combat climate change and promote sustainable energy.
 
 
 
• **Renewable Energy Targets**
 
 
• **India aims to achieve 175 GW of renewable energy capacity by 2022, which includes 100 GW from solar, 60 GW from wind, 10 GW from biomass, and 5 GW from small hydro**.
 
• The country is working towards an even more ambitious target of 450 GW of renewable energy capacity by 2030.
 
• These targets are part of India's commitment under the Paris Agreement to reduce carbon emissions.
 
 
 
• **Solar Power Advantages**
 
 
• Solar power is a clean and renewable source of energy, contributing to the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• It helps in reducing dependence on fossil fuels and enhances energy security.
 
• Solar energy systems have low operating costs and can be installed on various scales, from small rooftop systems to large solar farms.
